THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
KNITWEAR & LAYERS
123
STUDY 164
Denim Bustier, Maxi Skirt & Fur Bag
Rights check
Source: 25051.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, wavy copper hair
falls over one shoulder, with a long multicolor knit scarf
draped across her body. She wears a strapless fitted
denim bustier with frayed edges and button front,
paired with a dark washed denim maxi skirt with a
frayed hem. A fluffy leopard-print faux-fur bag and
brown pointed suede mules complete the look. Her
expression is calm and direct. Soft, gray studio
backdrop with even light. Palette of indigo denim, warm
brown, and multicolor knit. Warm and textured, in the
style of an autumn editorial.
Warm, layered, textured
WORKING NOTES
- The frayed denim and fur bag are the key textures.
- Keep the scarf for a layered, cozy finish.
Try this: Keep the scarf for a layered finish.
